stem: How does the author try to convince people that the entire community will benefit from a dog park?

options.label: A
options.text: He includes the advantages of a dog park for people who do not have pets.

options.label: B
options.text: He restates the fact that the town has a law requiring dogs to be leashed.

options.label: C
options.text: He mentions that dog owners should have a fence around their yard for their dog.

options.label: D
options.text: He proves that most dog owners feel that their dog is safer on a leash.
